final: WITH per_telescope_avg AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg FROM per_telescope_avg) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_modindex, p.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg as above_overall, p.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg as ratio FROM per_telescope_avg p CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE p.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
